errors.evidence: The pie chart does not show percentage values for the green ('81–100 услуги') and turquoise ('Не се предоставят') slices. The description invents the values 5.9% and 5%. While the total of the unlabeled slices is 10.9%, the individual breakdown is not provided in the figure.

errors.evidence: This statement is false. Two sectors, the green one ('81–100 услуги') and the turquoise one ('Не се предоставят'), are not labeled with their percentage values in the chart.

errors.evidence: The sectors are not arranged in descending order of size. Following the slices clockwise, the percentages are approximately 5% (hallucinated), 32.6%, 15.2%, 13%, 5.9% (hallucinated), and 28.3%. This is not a descending sequence.
